workspaces.description: Array of ComputerCatalogueEntry, at most 32; explicitly validated by the adapter.

complete.description: Boolean emitted from the owning contract; farol-wire/2 has no boolean primitive.

instructions.description: Ordered array of closed ComputerInstructionRead/Missing/Unavailable variants, at most 33; explicitly validated by the adapter.

entries.description: Array of at most 500 nonempty directory entry strings, each at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; explicitly validated by the adapter.
